evidence: Nestled in the heart of Hanoi, the vibrant capital city of Vietnam, lies the Thang Long Water Puppetry Theatre, a cultural gem that stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of Vietnamese traditional arts. Founded in 1969, this theatre is named after the ancient capital of Thang Long, which was established by King Ly Thai To in the 11th century, symbolizing the preservation of a cherished cultural heritage.
